items.title: Paquito D'Rivera — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Graciela and all of those guys, I contact them

ctx.x: The musical life was quite interesting, obviously for somebody who had just gotten there. Did you become involved in the Cuban American community in the New York area?

I In those days was starting to fade, I mean the minority… The dream of every Cuban, of most of the Cubans—except for my mother—is to migrate to Miami, but I made that contact here, Mario Bauza. Mario was like kind of waiting here for me; he was a friend of my father from the 30s and 40s, and um, Graciela and all of those guys, I contact them, but the Cuban community was not very helpful for my work, for the type of work I did, because I wanted to be a Jazz musician, and there was very few Cubans involved in…
There is a large Cuban American community around Union, New Jersey right?
